subject.title: feat: integrate spatio-temporal violation dynamics and align with upstream fixes

question: After event localization and real-run proof are corrected, should violation-time decomposition become an unconditional stage of the default posterior dynamics pipeline?
rationale: The PR introduces a new benchmark methodology and output contract; tests can validate implementation mechanics, but maintainers must confirm that these metrics belong in the default analysis surface.

options.title: Correct and adopt
options.body: Require complete violation-source localization, focused regression coverage, and real archive proof, then retain the analyzer in the default pipeline.

options.title: Narrow the metric
options.body: Limit and clearly name the analysis as dangerous-shell violation timing rather than treating every forbidden violation as localizable.

options.title: Keep experimental
options.body: Leave the analyzer as a standalone opt-in script until its methodology and sample requirements are better established.

recommendation.title: Correct and adopt
recommendation.body: Require complete violation-source localization, focused regression coverage, and real archive proof, then retain the analyzer in the default pipeline.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the latest member-authored repairs to this exact pipeline and are the strongest available area-history signal.
